Logseq SDK 0.3.4, shipped with Logseq Desktop 2.0.2 (revision 533ac43).
Unmodified js/lsplugin.user.js and its license notices from the official app.asar.
Upstream: https://github.com/logseq/logseq/tree/533ac43/libs
The bundled SDK is pinned because npm @logseq/libs still publishes 0.0.17,
which predates the DB-only command and property APIs.
